name: Rocket Pool
rootCause: A prominent Rocket Pool token holder lost approximately $3.8 million in RPL to a phishing attack on Ethereum Mainnet on March 30, 2023. No Rocket Pool protocol contracts were exploited; the attacker targeted a user's wallet using social engineering. The victim was deceived by phishing and authorized token transfers from their personal wallet. The attacker used wallet-drainer malware to steal RPL. No Rocket Pool smart contract vulnerability was involved.
